csv_project_name: AE Services for MB HD Steam Site Pipe Repairs
csv_scope_of_work: The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) Real Estate is requesting written responses to this Qualification Packet from qualified firms to provide professional consulting services for the MB HD STEAM SITE PIPE REPAIRS (PRJ-000648) project. The successful firm shall provide design, regulatory agency approval, construction bidding assistance, construction administration services, and project closeout services. The purpose of the project is to repair a 6-inch underground steam pipe serving the Helen Diller Building in the Mission Bay Campus to address water intrusion issues.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics
